introHtml: Mixie lip balms offer a unique, playful shape that stands out in any swag bag or office breakroom. Unlike standard tubes, these custom-printed balms in colorful cubes or balls grab attention and encourage use. Ideal for trade shows, employee wellness kits, or safety incentives, Mixie lip balms can be decorated with your logo using pad printing or labels. Choose from moisturizing formulas with SPF or natural ingredients to keep lips soft while promoting your brand.
